02 / IDENTITY

NOT JUST A
PROFILE.

MR. NINJA is the personal identity of Youssef: a young builder focused on websites, visual direction and practical digital experiences. The goal is simple — make the work look as serious as the idea behind it.

WHO IS MR. NINJA?

Youssef, 18, from Mansoura, Egypt. Web Designer, Web Developer and Graphic Designer. I care about how a digital product feels, reads and presents itself — not just whether the code runs.

THE APPROACH

Clear hierarchy. Strong visuals. Fast interactions. Every section has a job, every animation has a reason, and every screen should feel intentional.
